title: Prompt delivery
description: One prompt the product actually delivered. This is the input to the shared prompt budget (knowledge/heuristics/feedback-prompts.yaml#prompt_budget_per_day), so the shape is a fact, not a message: the copy lives in the message catalogue and the policy that reads this row is packages/nudges. The row is append-only in schemas/sql/schema.sql (no UPDATE/DELETE policy, refuse_mutation trigger), because rewriting a delivery would rewrite the reason a later prompt was or was not allowed.

userId.description: Server-assigned from the session (AGENTS rule 7); row-level security is the enforcement, and this field is the audit that the enforcement has something to key on.

kind.description: Which prompt was delivered. Every kind spends the same budget (feedback-prompts.yaml#one-budget-for-all-prompts), so the value is what a refusal is counted against.

day.description: The training day the prompt was delivered on. This is what the shared budget counts; a prompt delivered at 00:30 on the 6th still belongs to the training day the runner was in.

forDay.description: The day the prompt asked about: equal to `day` for a same-day nudge, earlier for a silence-ladder prompt. JSON Schema cannot order two dates, so `forDay <= day` is enforced by a CHECK in the DDL and by the policy that builds the row, not here.

atMinute.description: Local minute-of-day the prompt was scheduled for (0 = 00:00, 1439 = 23:59). Local, not UTC: the quiet-hours rule is about the runner's evening, and a UTC minute would move the window for every runner east of Greenwich.
